fields.label: MRP On The Pack
fields.description: What is actually printed on the pack on the shelf, read off it in the shop. Deliberately NOT filled in from the item master: the reason to record it is to find packs whose printed price no longer matches what the master says, and a figure copied from the master can never disagree with it.
